harpers.name: The Harpers
harpers.motto: Knowledge is power; balance in all things.
harpers.goals: Eliminate tyranny, promote equality, preserve ancient historical lore.

order_of_the_gauntlet.name: Order of the Gauntlet
order_of_the_gauntlet.goals: Smite evil and undead threats wherever they arise.

emerald_enclave.name: Emerald Enclave
emerald_enclave.goals: Protect the balance of nature against encroaching abominations and corruption.

lords_alliance.name: The Lords Alliance
lords_alliance.motto: Security and order through united rule.
lords_alliance.goals: Restore civilization and security to frontier settlements.

zhentarim.name: The Zhentarim (The Black Network)
zhentarim.motto: Wealth and power for those bold enough to seize it.
zhentarim.goals: Expand commercial and political dominance across the Sword Coast.
